text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought Rulership, who was feeling down
from a relentless streak of bad luck lately, to a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"My luck is so absurdly bad, it's not even funny.
I don't care what it takes anymore, just someone save m—"

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ngah! A cat!
S-Scary!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ha, haha... How's that?
You get it now, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Just how unlucky can I get...?
...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What's going ooon...?
Did I do something wrong...??

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership seemed
quite worn out.
choice_data_list: Let's go pay our respects at the shrine!
Let's go pay our respects at the shrine!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Let's do this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: (Please, I beg you...!! Please, someone save me, I'm begging you!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I think... that cleared my head a little bit?
It means I gotta build up more resilience too, right? Yeah."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Can I go check out that shop?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah. At storefronts of bookstores like this,
sometimes they sell used board games and stuff.
I come rummaging around looking for rare finds.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Well, it won't be that simple—...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ah!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's the board game I've been looking for forever!
The super-duper ultra-rare one you can't find anywhere anymore!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: How did I get so lucky...!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'll go buy it!
Then let's head right back and battle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the visit to the shrine had paid off.
Rulership walked with remarkably light steps.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After finishing the shrine visit and stepping out of the grounds...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pitter... patter...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Nobody said it was going to rain!
Ugh, this is the worst! The heavens are totally toying with me!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oh, fine then...! If that's how you want to be,
then I'm just not going outside for a while...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership grew even more disheartened,
and her slump continued on...
